LESSON: LOCOMOTIVE MOTOR SKILLS

Grade: PP2
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: BASIC
Topic 10.1: Locomotive MOTOR SKILLS

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Locomotive MOTOR SKILLS. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. climb and slide on playing objects for enjoyment
2. observe safety during climbing and sliding on playing objects throwing and catching games. First Aid skills. Core-Competence Self efficacy Learn to learn

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. climb and slide on playing objects for enjoyment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to climb and slide on playing objects for enjoyment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. observe safety during climbing and sliding on playing objects throwing and catching games. First Aid skills. Core-Competence Self efficacy Learn to learn
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to observe safety during climbing and sliding on playing objects throwing and catching games. First Aid skills. Core-Competence Self efficacy Learn to learn. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”
